exact.1×1 可當成通道方向的線性變換；放在貴的 3×3、5×5 前與 pooling: A 1×1 can be viewed as a linear transformation along the channel dimension; it is placed before the expensive 3×3 and 5×5 and after pooling to reduce dimensionality and redundancy.
exact.前處理零中心、核心是堆疊 Inception、卷積（含模組內）皆 ReLU，對應: Zero-centered preprocessing, a core of stacked Inception modules, and ReLU on every convolution (including those inside the modules): this matches the original text's description of Fig. 15.
exact.昂貴的 3×3、5×5 前先 1×1 壓通道；pooling 後也接 1×1，這: A 1×1 compresses the channels before the expensive 3×3 and 5×5, and a 1×1 also follows pooling: this is the key change of the final module compared with the early design.
exact.深層特徵更抽象，需要較大感受野，因此 3×3、5×5 比例提高；也因此更需要 1: Deeper features are more abstract and need larger receptive fields, so the share of 3×3 and 5×5 increases; that is also why 1×1 dimensionality reduction is needed even more to keep the computation under control.

a6831f9e5ea8.zh: Inception 與 GoogLeNet：多尺度與 1×1 降維 Inception and GoogLeNet: Multi-Scale & 1×1 Dimension Reduction
a6831f9e5ea8.en: Inception and GoogLeNet: Multi-Scale and 1×1 Dimensionality Reduction

b2aeae9c2562.zh: 加深加寬網路容易導致參數暴增與過擬合。奪得 ILSVRC 2014 桂冠的 GoogLeNet 給出了革命性解方：在同一層中並聯 1×1、3×3、5×5 與池化多尺度分支，更首創在昂貴大核前插入 1×1 卷積作為「降維瓶頸層（Bottleneck）」。看似只看單一畫素的 1×1 卷積，實現了通道方向的線性降維，讓網路「看起來極寬、算起來極瘦」！
b2aeae9c2562.en: Making a network deeper and wider easily leads to an explosion of parameters and overfitting. GoogLeNet, winner of ILSVRC 2014, offered a revolutionary solution: run 1×1, 3×3, 5×5 and pooling multi-scale branches in parallel within the same layer, and, for the first time, insert a 1×1 convolution before the expensive big kernels as a "dimensionality-reduction bottleneck layer". The 1×1 convolution, which seems to look at only a single pixel, performs linear dimensionality reduction along the channel direction, making the network "look extremely wide, but compute extremely lean"!

af355b292d21.zh:
「1×1 卷積視窗只有單個畫素，根本看不到任何空間形狀；
為何它反倒成為拯救深層神經網路免於算力崩潰的降維救星？」 1×1 不是看空間，而是跨通道線性混和與減肥！先 1×1 瘦身再做昂貴 5×5，計算量直接砍掉 70%！
1x1 operates across channels, not space! Compressing channels before large filters slashes FLOPs by over 70%!
af355b292d21.en:
“A 1×1 convolution window covers only a single pixel and cannot see any spatial shape at all;
so why has it become the dimensionality-reduction savior that rescues deep neural networks from a compute collapse?” 1×1 doesn't look at space; it linearly mixes and slims down across channels! Slim down with 1×1 first, then do the expensive 5×5, and the computation is cut by 70% outright!

f3658aecc279.zh: 02 / 多尺度並列哲學 · Multi-Scale Inception

d11cfe1dde2e.zh: 初版 Inception 模組：多尺度特徵並聯擷取 (Fig. 13) Naive Inception: Parallel Multi-Scale Receptive Fields (Fig. 13)
d11cfe1dde2e.en: The naive Inception module: extracting multi-scale features in parallel (Fig. 13)

0a03aa7a59f1.en: Why do we need multiple scales?

79a94371d374.zh: 在輸入影像中，不同物體或相同物體的關鍵特徵所佔據的畫素範圍截然不同。淺層網路中，微小局部的特徵團塊僅需 $1\times 1$ 即可處理；中等尺度的紋理需要 $3\times 3$；較廣泛的幾何結構則需要 $5\times 5$。
79a94371d374.en: In an input image, the key features of different objects, or even of the same object, occupy very different pixel extents. In shallow layers, tiny local feature blobs need only $1\times 1$; medium-scale textures need $3\times 3$; broader geometric structures need $5\times 5$.

c6c521ba0ee2.zh: 與其糾結在「這一層該用多大的核」，Inception 選擇小孩子才做選擇，我全都要：在同一層內部同時平行執行四條支路：
c6c521ba0ee2.en: Instead of agonizing over "how big a kernel should this layer use", Inception takes the attitude "only kids have to choose; I want them all": four branches run in parallel at the same time inside the same layer:

1d590c81c329.zh: $1\times 1$ 卷積支路： 捕捉單畫素級跨通道特徵。
1d590c81c329.en: $1\times 1$ convolution branch: captures single-pixel-level cross-channel features.

8a22f8333853.zh: $3\times 3$ 卷積支路： 捕捉局部鄰域紋理。
8a22f8333853.en: $3\times 3$ convolution branch: captures local neighborhood textures.

bb608356293b.zh: $5\times 5$ 卷積支路： 捕捉較大範圍的空間輪廓。
bb608356293b.en: $5\times 5$ convolution branch: captures spatial contours over a larger range.

aecf4a7f9e27.zh: $3\times 3$ Max Pooling 支路： 保留局部最強響應。
aecf4a7f9e27.en: $3\times 3$ max pooling branch: keeps the strongest local responses.

38e6c7bacda7.zh: 四條支路輸出在通道維度進行特徵串接（Filter Concatenation）。但如果通道很厚，直接算 $5\times 5$ 卷積將導致浮點運算量（FLOPs）徹底爆炸！
38e6c7bacda7.en: The outputs of the four branches are concatenated (filter concatenation) along the channel dimension. But if the channels are thick, computing the $5\times 5$ convolution directly makes the floating-point operation count (FLOPs) blow up completely!

08ebc2364247.zh: 03 / 瓶頸層降維視覺化 · Bottleneck Mechanism

5875115cee4a.zh: 最終版 Inception：1×1 瓶頸層的前置瘦身奇蹟 (Fig. 14) Final Inception: 1×1 Bottleneck Dimensionality Reduction (Fig. 14)
5875115cee4a.en: The final Inception: the miracle of slimming down first with a 1×1 bottleneck layer (Fig. 14)

d26f56678ea5.zh: Inception：多尺度仍要，但 5×5 太貴——先用 1×1 把通道減肥再做大核
d26f56678ea5.en: Inception: still multi-scale, but 5×5 is too costly—slim the channels with 1×1 before the big kernel

65825733555c.zh: 輸入通道 C=256 時，大核每個位置都做極厚乘法
65825733555c.en: With C=256 input channels, the big kernel does very thick multiplications at every position

5652513bfd2b.zh: 深層抽象特徵更需要大感受野 → 5×5 比例更高 → 計算癱瘓
5652513bfd2b.en: Deep abstract features need larger receptive fields → more 5×5 → computation grinds to a halt

688f4af23852.zh: 早期模組 (Fig. 13)：1×1／3×3／5×5／pool 並列，未經瘦身
688f4af23852.en: Early module (Fig. 13): 1×1 / 3×3 / 5×5 / pool in parallel, no slimming

fa821d4a3651.zh: 最終版 Inception：昂貴大核之前先做降維
fa821d4a3651.en: Final Inception: reduce dimensions before the expensive big kernels

712ed99cb27f.zh: 1×1 同步接在 pooling 之後，防範通道數肆意疊加
712ed99cb27f.en: A 1×1 also follows pooling, to keep channel counts from piling up

1ad1c65101bc.zh: 1×1 卷積＝通道維度上的線性重組與資訊濃縮
1ad1c65101bc.en: 1×1 convolution = linear recombination and condensing of information along the channel dimension

66b49e2c4a32.zh: GoogLeNet＝堆疊 Inception 模組（向 LeNet 致敬）· ILSVRC 2014 冠軍
66b49e2c4a32.en: GoogLeNet = stacked Inception modules (a nod to LeNet) · ILSVRC 2014 winner

1b3d6b0a0c6e.zh: 輸入 224×224×3 先減 RGB 均值；所有卷積均接 ReLU；越深層配置越多 3×3／5×5 大感受野
1b3d6b0a0c6e.en: Input 224×224×3, RGB mean subtracted first; every conv followed by ReLU; deeper layers get more 3×3 / 5×5 large receptive fields

a7736d073f8e.zh: 大師洞察：加寬加深深怕過擬合與算爆——用 1×1 瓶頸讓網路「看起來極寬、算起來極瘦」！
a7736d073f8e.en: Master insight: widening and deepening risks overfitting and blowing the compute—a 1×1 bottleneck makes the network "look extremely wide, but compute extremely lean"!

bf62bb59694b.zh: 圖 14.1：Inception 模組 1×1 降維瓶頸層演進與四支路並聯對比
bf62bb59694b.en: Figure 14.1: Evolution of the Inception module's 1×1 dimensionality-reduction bottleneck layer and comparison of the four parallel branches

3d06418d09d3.zh: 在原書教材 Fig. 14 中，1×1 降維的位置有嚴格的幾何講究：
3d06418d09d3.en: In the textbook's Fig. 14, the placement of the 1×1 dimensionality reduction follows strict geometric logic:

dfe31e741f2f.zh: 在昂貴的 $3\times 3$ 與 $5\times 5$ 之前：先將厚通道壓扁，大幅減少乘加運算。
dfe31e741f2f.en: Before the expensive $3\times 3$ and $5\times 5$: first flatten the thick channels, greatly reducing the multiply-add operations.

3ebd23ad92fa.zh: 在 $3\times 3$ Max Pooling 之後：池化本身不改變通道數，若直接拼接會讓輸出通道暴增，故池化後接 $1\times 1$ 控制通道數。
3ebd23ad92fa.en: After the $3\times 3$ max pooling: pooling itself does not change the number of channels, and concatenating it directly would make the output channels explode, so a $1\times 1$ follows the pooling to control the channel count.

74bb61d5dd22.zh: 🔭 深層與感受野配比規律
74bb61d5dd22.en: 🔭 How depth and receptive field proportions scale

38f6f73885cf.zh: 越靠近網路輸出端，特徵越抽象，需要更大的感受野以捕捉全域語意。因此 GoogLeNet 在較深層的 Inception 模組中，主動調高了 $3\times 3$ 與 $5\times 5$ 的比重。
38f6f73885cf.en: The closer to the network's output, the more abstract the features, and the larger the receptive field needed to capture global semantics. So in its deeper Inception modules, GoogLeNet deliberately raises the share of $3\times 3$ and $5\times 5$.

f9d492857e3a.zh: 📌 本單元核心總結：Inception 與瓶頸降維 Key Takeaways: Multi-Scale Inception & Bottlenecks

9a337dca2a1e.zh: 多尺度並聯（Fig. 13）： 1×1、3×3、5×5 與 Pooling 同時並聯，克服單一尺度感受野侷限，兼顧局部細節與全域特徵。
9a337dca2a1e.en: Multi-scale parallelism (Fig. 13): 1×1, 3×3, 5×5 and pooling run in parallel at the same time, overcoming the limits of a single-scale receptive field and covering both local details and global features.

1cec6920abfc.zh: 1×1 瓶頸層降維（Fig. 14）： 昂貴大核前先以 1×1 壓縮通道數，Pooling 後接 1×1 抑制作為，算力節省超過 70%。

282ec46666db.zh: 感受野深層遞增： 隨網路加深逐步擴大 $3\times 3$ 與 $5\times 5$ 的配比，完美迎合高階抽象語意表徵的宏觀需求！
282ec46666db.en: Receptive fields growing with depth: the share of $3\times 3$ and $5\times 5$ is gradually increased as the network deepens, perfectly meeting the big-picture needs of high-level abstract semantic representations!
